Subject: Pricing & startup discount — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap + a few asks so we can get a formal proposal to procurement.

Summary from our call:
- Goal: Replace existing embedding+chat pipeline to improve latency and 4x cheaper unit costs over run-rate.
- Expected ramp: pilot (Q4) -> production (Q1) with steady-state in month 6.
- Key asks from your side: target $/1M tokens, procurement timelines, and whether you qualify for startup program or need committed-use pricing.

A few asks for the proposal:
1) Can you confirm expected token volumes by month (pilot -> month 6)? rough ranges are fine (e.g., 5M -> 40M tokens/month).
2) Do you have a target price per 1M tokens you need to land on? (helps me map to tiers)
3) Is procurement the Gaia Miller <gaia.miller@avahealth.com> email you shared?

What I can offer (high level):
- Redwood Startup Program: credits + 20–30% off list for eligible early-stage customers (details attached).
- Committed-use discounts: tiered across 12/24-month terms — deeper discounts for multi-year revenue commits.

Next steps: If you share the volume numbers and the procurement contact, I’ll send a formal pricing spreadsheet + the startup T&Cs and propose a cadence for a procurement/legal call.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
https://redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few numbers to help you price: 

Estimated token profile (rough):
- Pilot (month 1-2): 5–8M tokens/month
- Ramp (month 3-5): 15–30M tokens/month
- Steady state (month 6+): ~40M tokens/month

Budget/target economics:
- Target price: ideally $25 / 1M tokens or lower (we know this is aggressive)
- Budget: ~$10k/month during pilot, scaling to $60–80k/month at steady state

Procurement: yes — route procurement through Gaia Miller (gaia.miller@avahealth.com). She’ll own PO and contract reviews.

Question: what minimum committed monthly volume do you require for the 12-month committed discount? Also curious about multi-year incentives (24+ month). If you can show a model that hits ~$25/1M with a 12 or 24 month commit we’ll take that to the CFO.

—
Alex
Head of AI, Ava Health
alex.jones@avahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & startup discount — follow up with proposed tiers (see attachments)

Appreciate the detail, Alex — this is exactly what we need to size a committed proposal. Attached is a working pricing sheet (proposed_pricing_avahealth.xlsx) and the startup program T&Cs. Key points below (high-level, discount shown off list):

Baseline list (example — per 1M tokens):
- 0–5M: $40 / 1M
- 5–20M: $30 / 1M
- 20–100M: $20 / 1M

Committed-use discounts (applies to list above):
- 12-month commit: 20% off list
- 24-month commit: 30% off list
- Volume uplift incentives: additional 5% for >50M tokens/month sustained for 3 months

Startup program:
- If Ava qualifies (early-stage, under thresholds in T&Cs), we can provide $10k platform credits + an introductory 25% off list for the first 6 months (stackable with certain commit discounts; see T&Cs).

What this means for your target $25 / 1M:
- Example: steady-state 40M tokens/month buckets mostly in 20–100M tier at $20/1M list -> with 12-month commit (20% off) = $16/1M (well under $25).
- If volume is lower during ramp, the effective blended price will be higher — the attached sheet has a month-by-month blended example.

Minimums & approval notes:
- For a 12-month committed pricing to apply we typically require an annual minimum revenue commit (ARR-equivalent) — I’ve modelled a few options in the sheet, but roughly a 12-month commit at ~24M tokens/month gets you into the $16–$20 blended range.
- Multi-year (24-mo) incentives need Sales Manager approval for discounts >25% off list; ben and laura are cc’ed to review.

Next steps:
1) Alex: confirm which commit window you want me to model (12 v 24) and confirm the month-by-month volumes in the sheet.
2) Gaia: once we have the committed proposal we’ll route to legal/PO — I’ll include the exact DocuSign links and SOW.
3) I’ll schedule a procurement call — does Oct 16 at 10:00 AM PT work?

Thanks — attaching the files now.

—
Marissa

Attachments: proposed_pricing_avahealth.xlsx, redwood_startup_program_terms.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pricing & startup discount — follow up with proposed tiers (internal approval note)

Marissa / Alex — looping in quick internal guidance.

- We can approve the 12-month commit at the discount levels Marissa outlined (12-month: ~20% off list) without exec escalation.
- For a 24-month term with >25% off list (effectively giving you to that $16/1M blended range depending on volumes), I’ll need to confirm threshold ARR and get an AM/RevOps sign-off — should be doable for this account given the volume profile Alex shared.
- Legal: standard SOW + PO, no unusual clauses expected; procurement can expect a redlined contract within 48–72 hours after agreement on numbers.

Marissa — will you include the ARR-equivalent numbers (annual $) in the final sheet so I can sign off faster? Alex — if you can confirm whether CFO prefers 12 vs 24 month modeling ahead of the call, that’ll speed approvals.

Ben
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
